escalation: Class 11. Anchor display "Targ. Y. I ib." (Targum Yerushalmi I / Pseudo-Jonathan on Deut. XXXII, 24) carries data-ref "Onkelos Deuteronomy 32:24", inherited byte-for-byte from the immediately preceding "Targ. Deut. XXXII, 24" anchor: the work qualifier in the display is discarded and the citation is routed to Onkelos. Only 5 such Targ. Y. -> Onkelos anchors exist corpus-wide (all of them the "ib." form), so this is not the systemic slash/href family. Same entry, second finding: the plural cross-reference displays "רְוַוח I" but targets "Jastrow, רְוַוח ² 1" (T00329), whose own print numeral is II (alt_headword רְוַח II); the numeral I names T00327. Maintainer must pick the intended article; no repair bytes exist in the entry.

Class 11. The Hif. stem section opens with an anchor whose display is "same" and whose data-ref is "Jastrow, רוֹטְנָנִית 1" — the alphabetically preceding entry ("grumbling, discontented"), not this entry's own base stem. In a stem section of an entry carrying no "ch." marker, "same" can only mean the preceding stem of this same verb. The correct destination is this entry (T00358, רוי); the bytes for it are not present in the entry, so no replace is possible.

Class 11 (patches P000002/P000003 repair a separate class-6/class-4 defect and ride along). In the Pa. section, "Targ. Hos. VI, 3 (h. text יורה)" anchors the unvocalized display יורה to "Jastrow, יוֹרֶה II 1" (J00240, the denominative of אוּר). Hos. VI, 3 יוֹרֶה is the early rain, which is J00239 יוֹרֶה I ("a soaking rain, early rain"). The two headwords share one vocalization and are separated only by the Roman numeral, so the linker had no vocalization signal and chose context-free. Maintainer call; the correct data-ref bytes are absent from the entry.

Class 11. The whole entry is ", v. <display>" and the display is רָכְבָּא, but the data-ref is "Jastrow, רִכְבָּא 1" (T00749, "upper millstone"). T00750 רָכְבָא ("= h. רַכָּב, rider") shares the consonantal skeleton רכבא and matches both the display's vocalization and this entry's own meaning (רוֹכְבָא, rider). Per the v4 niqqud carve-out the vocalization cannot be waived here because a second headword shares the skeleton. No replacement bytes exist in the entry.
